annotations.title: Autonomous Web SEO Diagnostics & Heading Hierarchy Auditor

description: Audits HTML heading structures, title lengths, meta descriptions, image alt tags, and OpenGraph compliance into a health score. Use when auditing landing pages, verifying SEO compliance before publishing, or evaluating crawl friendliness; for extracting article bodies, use scrape_readable_article instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' ('audit_level' defaults to 'comprehensive_audit'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

audit_level.description: Diagnostic audit scope: comprehensive audit, meta tags only, or heading hierarchy only.

html_content.description: Web page HTML string to evaluate against search engine optimization standards.

target_keyword.description: Primary search keyword to check for in titles, headings, and meta tags.

name: evaluate_seo_diagnostics

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for evaluate_seo_diagnostics.

heading_structure.description: Summary counts of H1 through H6 headings and hierarchy validity.

missing_attributes.description: List of missing SEO elements such as missing alt text or missing meta tags.

recommendations.description: Actionable recommendations for resolving detected search optimization issues.

seo_score.description: Aggregate SEO compliance score on a 0 to 100 benchmark scale.

title: Autonomous Web SEO Diagnostics & Heading Hierarchy Auditor
